source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves paradoxical living stone and human/divine evaluations.
key_decisions.before: As you come to him, a living stone rejected by men but chosen and precious in the sight of God,
key_decisions.after: As you come to him, a living stone rejected by people but chosen and honored by God,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: As you come to him, a living stone rejected by men but chosen and precious in the sight of God,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps building, priestly and sacrificial images.
key_decisions.before: you yourselves, like living stones, are being built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.after: you yourselves, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: you yourselves, like living stones, are being built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains Zion, cornerstone and emphatic promise.
key_decisions.before: For it stands in Scripture: “Behold, I am laying in Zion a stone, a cornerstone chosen and precious, and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame.”
key_decisions.after: For Scripture contains this: “Look, I lay in Zion a chosen and honored cornerstone, and the one who believes in him will never be put to shame.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For it stands in Scripture: “Behold, I am laying in Zion a stone, a cornerstone chosen and precious, and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps honor and rejection reversal.
key_decisions.before: So the honor is for you who believe, but for people who do not believe, “The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
key_decisions.after: So honor belongs to you who believe. But for those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So the honor is for you who believe, but for those who do not believe, “The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves both stone images, disobedience and difficult appointment claim.
key_decisions.before: and “A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word, as they were destined to do.
key_decisions.after: and, “a stone that makes people stumble and a rock that makes them fall.” They stumble because they disobey the word, to which they were also appointed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and “A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word, as they were destined to do.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps four corporate titles and darkness/light movement.
key_decisions.before: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for his possession, so that you may proclaim the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
key_decisions.after: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's possession, so that you may proclaim the excellencies of the one who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for his possession, so that you may proclaim the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves paired past/present reversals.
key_decisions.before: Once you were not a people, but now you are God’s people; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
key_decisions.after: Once you were not a people, but now you are God's people; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Once you were not a people, but now you are God’s people; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps alien status and military image.
key_decisions.before: Beloved, I urge you as sojourners and exiles to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which wage war against the soul.
key_decisions.after: Beloved, I urge you as foreigners and temporary residents to abstain from fleshly desires that wage war against your life.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Beloved, I urge you as sojourners and exiles to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which wage war against the soul.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains accusation, visible acts and visitation.
key_decisions.before: Keep your conduct among the nations honorable, so that when they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day of visitation.
key_decisions.after: Maintain honorable conduct among the nations so that, where they accuse you as evildoers, they may observe your good works and glorify God on the day he visits.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Keep your conduct among the nations honorable, so that when they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day of visitation.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps political submission and highest ruler.
key_decisions.before: Be subject for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the emperor as supreme,
key_decisions.after: For the Lord's sake, submit to every human institution, whether to the emperor as supreme
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Be subject for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the emperor as supreme,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves delegated punitive and commendatory roles.
key_decisions.before: or to governors as sent by him to punish people who do wrong and to praise people who do right.
key_decisions.after: or to governors sent by him to punish evildoers and praise those who do good.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: or to governors as sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps moral action as answer to accusation.
key_decisions.before: For this is the will of God, that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish people.
key_decisions.after: For this is God's will: by doing good, silence the ignorance of foolish people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For this is the will of God, that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish people.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves freedom/slavery paradox and concealment warning.
key_decisions.before: Live as people who are free, not using your freedom as a cover for evil, but living as servants of God.
key_decisions.after: Live as free people, but do not use freedom as a cover for evil; live as God's slaves.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Live as people who are free, not using your freedom as a cover for evil, but living as servants of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps four concise commands and distinguishes fear from honor.
key_decisions.before: Honor everyone. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the emperor.
key_decisions.after: Honor everyone, love the family of believers, fear God and honor the emperor.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Honor everyone. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the emperor.

key_decisions.rationale: Names slavery, masters and unjust treatment directly.
key_decisions.before: Servants, be subject to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle but also to the unjust.
key_decisions.after: Household slaves, submit with full fear to your masters—not only to the good and gentle but also to the cruel.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Servants, be subject to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle but also to the unjust.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains suffering's injustice and Godward conscience.
key_decisions.before: For this is a gracious thing, when mindful of God, one endures sorrows while suffering unjustly.
key_decisions.after: For it is commendable if someone endures painful suffering unjustly because of consciousness of God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For this is a gracious thing, when mindful of God, one endures sorrows while suffering unjustly.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps physical abuse, ethical contrast and divine evaluation.
key_decisions.before: For what credit is it if, when you sin and are beaten for it, you endure? But if when you do good and suffer for it you endure, this is a gracious thing in the sight of God.
key_decisions.after: What credit is there if you endure beatings for sinning? But if you endure suffering for doing good, this is commendable before God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For what credit is it if, when you sin and are beaten for it, you endure? But if when you do good and suffer for it you endure, this is a gracious thing in the sight of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves call, representative suffering and footsteps.
key_decisions.before: For to this you have been called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, so that you might follow in his steps.
key_decisions.after: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example so that you might follow in his steps.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For to this you have been called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, so that you might follow in his steps.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains nonretaliation and divine judgment.
key_decisions.before: When he was reviled, he did not revile in return; when he suffered, he did not threaten, but entrusted himself to the one who judges justly.
key_decisions.after: When insulted, he did not insult in return; when suffering, he made no threats, but entrusted himself to the one who judges justly.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: When he was reviled, he did not revile in return; when he suffered, he did not threaten, but entrusted himself to the one who judges justly.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps body, execution tree, death/life and singular wound.
key_decisions.before: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. By his wounds you have been healed.
key_decisions.after: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that, having died to sins, we might live for righteousness. By his wound you were healed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. By his wounds you have been healed.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains animal image and both care titles.
key_decisions.before: For you were straying like sheep, but have now returned to the shepherd and overseer of your souls.
key_decisions.after: For you were straying like sheep, but now you have returned to the shepherd and overseer of your lives.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For you were straying like sheep, but have now returned to the shepherd and overseer of your souls.
